name: Parallel-SSHI-Zener
rationale: The Reference FBR failed due to insufficient power (S2, S4) and overvoltage/ripple (S3). I am proposing a Parallel Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) topology. By adding an inductor L1 and a switch S1 that flips the piezoelectric capacitance voltage at its extrema, we significantly increase the energy extracted per cycle, which should fix the Vout_min and startup failures. To address the Vout_max and ripple failures in S3, I have added a Zener diode (DZ33) as a clamp on the output node and a larger storage capacitor. This combination provides higher efficiency, voltage regulation, and reduced ripple.
